column2: we need to zap mmio sptes.
zap_all() is used for this and this is causing two problems:

column1: - extra page faults after zapping mmu pages
- long mmu_lock hold time during zapping mmu pages

column2: Marcelo reported a disastrous mmu_lock hold time during
which made the guest unresponsive for a long time.

column1: This patch takes a simple way to fix these problems: do not zap mmu
pages unless they are marked mmio cached.  On our test box
only 50us for the 4GB guest and we did not see ms of mmu_lock hold time
Note that we still need to do zap_all() for other cases.  So another
work is also needed: Xiao's work may be the one.
